name: Enjouji Atsushi
source:
Atsusi is a rather unkind individual, especially when it comes to Yuuya, and he is hard on him and picks on him often. He could be considered your typical school bully, and the quiet Yuuya is his chosen prey.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/crain/crain.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
